About DeRa Shinwari BBQ

DeRa Shinwari BBQ & Family Restaurant brings traditional Shinwari-style BBQ and warm family dining to the heart of Sillanwali. Every dish is prepared with fresh ingredients and authentic BBQ flavours, served in a welcoming, family-friendly setting.

Whether you're dining in, driving through, or ordering for no-contact delivery, we bring the same quality and care to every table and every order.
